feature: The Sunfish's hull-deck seam at the transom closes: the transom's outline runs sheer to sheer and faces aft, and the deck moulding's flange fills the crown over the transom's top.
features: transom outline: the mirror leaves out the keel point (tr[1:]), not the sheer point; its top edge was from one sheer corner to 25 mm under the other, it faced forward and left holes into the hull (build_fleet.shell, Sunfish only)
the deck's after edge closed down to the transom's top under the crown (12 mm at the centreline), facing aft (build_fleet.deck, crown_table boats: the Sunfish)
references: The blind reviewers' notes on round 1 (a dark line along the transom's top); a ray cast from astern found the holes and the slot.
mac_note: No game code changes. The Mac rebakes and reimports the Sunfish.
findings: Round 2's three blind reviewers (sailor, boatbuilder, 3D artist) all preferred the closed seam; the old one read as a deck floating over a hollow hull.

Their notes for later: the faceted forefoot (stair steps under the bow); a dark sliver at the stem; the rubrail ending in knobs at the transom corners instead of carrying across; a sharp deck-to-transom corner with no flange lip or radius; the daggerboard and rudder as plain slabs; the rudder blade long against the real one.
The other fleet boats share the old transom outline (one sheer corner skipped, facing forward): a later round with their rebakes; the loop's scope is the J/22 hero and the Sunfish.
